mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_user (username, email, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_user SET username = #{username}, email = #{email}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, created_at, updated_at FROM rag_user WHERE username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, username, email, created_at, updated_at FROM rag_user ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, username, email, created_at, updated_at FROM rag_user ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
